name: Yunjian Equipment
aliases: 辽宁云舰风电设备有限公司
note: Back-of-shirt sponsor of Liaoning Tieren for the 2026 CSL season (also on the 2025 back, per NetEase, 2025-03: '背后的广告则是辽宁工行和云舰装备'). Identified from search-index snippets as Liaoning Yunjian Wind Power Equipment Co., Ltd. (辽宁云舰风电设备有限公司), registered in Yingkou on 2024-06-20 with RMB 5 million registered capital and legal representative Wang Qiang (王强) — small wind-power equipment maker that also makes club fan workwear (per a 2025 club article). Its shareholders could not be verified: qichacha, aiqicha and similar registry pages block scripts, so the owner is unverified and the sponsor stays unrated.
